About the school

A place where ability is seen before disability

Founded in 2007 at Bethany Ashram, Mardala, Jeevan Jyothi — “light of life” — serves families across Kadaba, Puttur and the wider Dakshina Kannada district. Many of our students come from rural homes where specialised support is otherwise hard to reach.

Alongside a regular curriculum, every child receives individual attention, therapy and practical skills that build confidence, independence and dignity — so they can grow into contributing members of their communities.

Individual education plansWheelchair-friendly campusCaring, trained staff
What we offer

Learning for the whole child

Academics, therapy and skills — shaped around each child’s pace and potential.

Special education

Grades 1–12 with functional academics, communication and daily-living skills, taught in small groups.

Therapy & care

Physiotherapy and medical support that ease physical difficulties and improve mobility.

Vocational training

Tailoring, candle making, areca palm-plate making and computer data entry for older students.

Horticulture

Hands-on mushroom, flower and vegetable cultivation on campus.

Arts, yoga & dance

Yoga, art and craft, music and dance that build expression, focus and joy.

Sports & culture

Team sports, cultural competitions and festivals that celebrate every student on stage.

School life

Every festival, every milestone — together

Onam, Deepavali, Christmas, Independence Day and Tulunadu culture — our children celebrate them all.

2nd

Our students won second place in the variety show at EMBOLDEN 2025, the Down syndrome awareness celebration at Father Muller, Mangaluru.

Support us

Help bring more children to school

Many children with disabilities who live far from Mardala stay at home because there is no accessible transport. An accessible school bus, sponsoring a child’s education, or a gift towards therapy equipment changes a life.
